title: Ice-age gray farm and granary with 13 tunnels in an L-shaped valley
summary: Charles Hall tells of Ice-age gray farm and granary with 13 tunnels in an L-shaped valley, about last ice age at L-shaped desert valley, western deserts (central Nevada), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
place_text: L-shaped desert valley, western deserts (central Nevada)

tellings.quote: And in the mountain on the west, they'd cut 13 tunnels in the in the mountain on the west and they used them as a grainery.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years with tall white aliens at Area 51, a secret US Air Force test site in Nevada, told podcast host Jesse Michels about an L-shaped valley in the desert of central Nevada. He says that during the last ice age, gray aliens (small gray-skinned beings) ran a farm there and cut 13 tunnels into the mountain on the valley's west side to use as a granary. If true, it would mean aliens were growing food on Earth long before recorded history.
